name: Ho Chi Minh City to Can Gio
summary: Go by road and the Bình Khánh ferry. It is about 50 km and about 1.5 to 2 hours to the mangrove forest. The Cần Giờ bridge is not open yet, so the short ferry over the Soài Rạp is still the crossing. Avoid public holidays, when the ferry queue can run to hours.

modes.mode: Car or motorbike, with the ferry
modes.duration: About 1 hour 30 minutes, or about 2 hours
modes.note: Nguyễn Văn Linh, then Huỳnh Tấn Phát to its end at the Bình Khánh ferry, then the forest road. About 50 km to the forest. The ferry itself is about 10–15 minutes on the water.
Bus 20 to the ferry, then bus 90 to Cần Thạnh; or bus 75 direct from Công viên 23/9. Tell the driver where you want to get off. Fares and minutes are Check on arrival.
About 1.2 km across the Soài Rạp. It takes walkers, bicycles, motorbikes, and cars. Fares and the timetable are Check on arrival.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City to Can Gio — road and the Bình Khánh ferry
seoDescription: About 50 km and 1.5 to 2 hours by road and the Bình Khánh ferry to the Can Gio mangroves. Buses 20 and 90, or 75. The bridge is not open.

faqs.q: Is the Cần Giờ bridge open?
faqs.a: No. Ground was broken in January 2026, and opening is hoped for in 2029. Until then the Bình Khánh ferry is the crossing.

faqs.q: How bad can the ferry queue get?
faqs.a: On the 30 April 2026 holiday, the queue on Huỳnh Tấn Phát ran nearly 2 hours. Go on a weekday if you can.
